title: Level 6 Diploma in Information Technology and Data Security
description: Develop advanced knowledge and practical skills in information technology, programming, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data management, and secure digital systems.
longDescription: This Level 6 Diploma in Information Technology and Data Security provides learners with advanced knowledge of computing, information technology, programming, networks, databases, software development, and information security. The programme develops practical expertise in Python programming, coding theory, numerical methods, artificial intelligence, and comparative programming languages. Learners explore computer systems, networks, database design, software development, computer modernisation and repair, and the principles of information and data security. The programme also develops professional, academic, communication, business, and problem-solving skills through academic writing, professional practice, community service, and industrial practice. Learners gain an interdisciplinary understanding of the social, economic, ethical, political, and environmental contexts in which modern information technologies are developed and applied. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 240 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
courseDetails: Evaluate advanced concepts and technologies in information technology, computer systems, networks, databases, software development, and information security. Design and develop software solutions using appropriate programming languages, programming principles, algorithms, coding theory, and development methodologies. Apply Python programming, numerical methods, artificial intelligence, and computational techniques to solve complex information technology problems. Analyse and implement appropriate information security principles and practices to protect data, systems, networks, and digital resources from emerging security threats. Evaluate technological solutions critically, considering their technical, ethical, social, economic, environmental, and organisational implications. Demonstrate professional and practical competence through academic writing, professional practice, community service learning, and industrial practice, while applying effective communication and problem-solving skills. entry: Level 6 Diploma in Information Technology and Data Security, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
progression: Upon completing the Level 6 Diploma in Information Technology and Data Security students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
